Verify important figures against the official budget. This Explorer is an independent transcription created to make the budget easier to search. It is not an official Jack County publication. We have reviewed and corrected identified issues, but transcription, OCR or data-entry errors may remain. If the Explorer differs from the county record, rely on the county record. The FY2026-27 figures shown here are from the September 10, 2026 work budget and may change before final adoption.

About this data

FY26 Adopted comes from the original FY2025-26 adopted budget. FY26 Current is the 2026 budget column printed in the September 10, 2026 work budget and can differ if the budget was amended.

The September work budget is an image-only scan. During this rebuild, 141 rows that failed automated parsing checks were reviewed against the source PDF, including 18 rows explicitly marked corrected. Two pages omitted by the original parser, the County Treasurer and Tax Assessor-Collector pages, were also added directly from the source documents.

Office / function is a public-navigation aid, not an official county accounting classification. The underlying fund, budget section, account number and source page remain visible. Shared or countywide expenses are not automatically allocated to individual offices.

Load another entity: This version can load a normalized Budget Explorer JSON dataset locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server. A future import workflow can guide CSV/PDF normalization before publication.
